name: dataleap-design-system
description: shadcn/ui skeleton with the DataLeap brand pinned: brand-green primary (#18A00D/#5AC750), independent info/success/warning/destructive status palette, six-color green-anchored categorical chart scale (chart-1..6), stock neutral oklch surfaces, Geist font. 60 components; Badge, Alert, and AvatarBadge carry local variant additions.

tokens.notes: Semantic CSS variables in :root (light) and .dark (dark). Radius scale derives from the single --radius base. Neutrals use oklch; brand, chart, and status colors use hex.

components.notes: One file per component, stock shadcn source with local variant additions in Badge, Alert, and Avatar. Import alias: @/components/ui/<name>.
